title: 第15章 制甲第16章 制弩
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
李秦武打定主意去人类村庄劫掠一波，反正是异世界的人类，搞他们自己一点心理负担没有。
不过就自己麾下这些臭洋溢烂鸟蛋，他真怕千里送人头，为此要提前准备！
先来一手征兵，除了自己可以绝对信任的19个系统兵外，李秦武招募了200个哥布林，让他们成为脱产士兵。
李秦武给每只哥布林都准备了木矛，然后让他们进行军训。
军训内容很简单，长矛捅刺，提升他们的战斗力。
跑步，提升他们的机动能力。
站军姿，提升他们的服从性和团队意识。
前两项都好说，在食物的诱惑下，哥布林们都能完成，可是最后一项站军姿就要老命了。
哥布林天生喜动，一个个和多动症一样，你让他们在太阳下站一个小时不能动，这对他们来说简直是酷刑！
李秦武亲自监督，搞了几次都不太行，这些家伙列队站着站着就开始有小动作，说小话，甚至干脆摆烂，一屁股坐在地上，让李秦武头痛至极。
军姿这东西吧，确实够折磨人，不要说哥布林了，就算人类都有些受不了，需要有老兵看着。
这东西主要为了培养个体对于军令的服从性，毕竟让部队在太阳底下不准动站一个小时有意义吗？没有。
可这种没意义的命令士兵都坚决服从了，那长官以后派士兵去进行各种战术任务，他们不是更会服从吗？
尤其是哥布林这些魔物，他们更应该接受军姿训练的洗礼，培养他们对命令的无条件服从。
为此李秦武是和他们杠上了，哥布林必须通过军姿训练！
李秦武纠正过好几次，连军棍都打上了，还是不行，这东西和哥布林混沌的本能对冲。
李秦武直接发飙了，他把持矛哥布林叫过来，让他们站在哥布林方阵前面。
“把他们盯好，谁要是敢动，敢说话，敢随便乱走，直接杀！”
李秦武懒得和他们纠缠了，直接用哥布林最能听得懂的语言，不服从就杀！
果然，这套非常奏效，面对同类的夺命长矛，哥布林一个个站在那里不敢动弹，也不敢讲话，连站三个小时都不吱声。

李秦武满意的点了点头，果然，哥布林还是欠抽，就得用这种方法，这么搞下去，他有信心在一个月内培养出这些哥布林的服从性，一个月后就能出兵了。
除了军事训练，李秦武还有其他准备。
首先是继续刷等级，李秦武每天带着士兵去猎杀角鳄，不但他自己要升级，他也要给手下的哥布林们升升级。
这些哥布林实在太矮，拉去和人类干和小孩打大人一样，他必须把19个士兵全部练成2级兵大哥布林。
为此他一直连刷了两天的角鳄，终于，最先跟随他的哥布矛攒够了经验，李秦武在士兵管理页面点击升级，花费80蒂纳尔，将哥布矛升级成大哥布林。
哥布矛的身高瞬间攀升到1米7，他不可置信看着自己强壮的身体，澎湃的力量让他感觉到了脱胎换骨的爽感。
李秦武把哥布矛扯到众哥布林面前，指着他大喊：“哥布矛因作战勇敢！被我赐予了力量！从今以后他就是部落里的第2只大哥布林了！
你们不想获得同样的力量吗？想吗？想的话就给我努力战斗！”
叮！您进行了一次成功的演讲，激发了哥布林们的热情，魅力熟练度＋1。
看着哥布林们狂热的战意，李秦武非常满意，只要他们能保持这种热情，打下人类部落真的不成问题！
接下来几天，河边的角鳄遭老罪了，被哥布林们勾引上岸狂杀，陆续又有很多哥布林经验攒够，李秦武将他们全部升级成了大哥布林。
大哥布林的战斗力比人类男性强，智慧也和人类差不多，李秦武决定了，等手里的所有哥布林都晋升成大哥布林，就出兵人类村庄！
content_en:
Li Qinwu made up his mind to plunder a human village. Since they were humans from another world, there was no psychological burden on them.
But with these stinking rotten eggs under his command, he was really afraid of being killed thousands of miles away, so he had to prepare in advance for this!
First, he recruited soldiers. In addition to the 19 system soldiers he could absolutely trust, Li Qinwu recruited 200 goblins and turned them into full-time soldiers.
Li Qinwu prepared wooden spears for each goblin and then asked them to conduct military training.
The content of military training is very simple, stabbing with spears to improve their combat effectiveness.
Running, improving their mobility.
Stand in a military posture to improve their obedience and team awareness.
The first two items are easy to say. Under the temptation of food, the goblins can complete them, but the last one will be fatal if they stand in a military posture.
Goblins are naturally active, and they all have ADHD. If you make them stand in the sun for an hour without moving, it is simply torture for them!
Li Qinwu personally supervised it, but it didn't work a few times. When these guys stood in line, they started to make small moves, talk small words, and even just sit down on the ground, giving Li Qinwu a severe headache.
The military posture is really torturous. Not to mention the goblins, even humans can't stand it. They need to be watched by veterans.
This thing is mainly to cultivate individual obedience to military orders. After all, does it make sense to make the troops not allowed to stand under the sun for an hour? No.
But the soldiers resolutely obeyed such meaningless orders. If the commander sends soldiers to carry out various tactical tasks in the future, wouldn't they be more obedient?
Especially monsters like goblins should receive the baptism of military posture training to cultivate their unconditional obedience to orders.
For this reason, Li Qinwu came into conflict with them, and the goblins had to pass military posture training!
Li Qinwu corrected him several times, even using the military stick, but it still didn't work. This thing clashed with the goblin's chaotic instinct.
Li Qinwu went crazy. He called the spear goblins over and asked them to stand in front of the goblin square.
"Keep an eye on them. If anyone dares to move, speak, or walk around, kill them directly!"
Li Qinwu was too lazy to argue with them, so he directly used the language that the goblins could understand best. If they didn't obey, they would be killed!
Sure enough, this method was very effective. Facing the same kind of life-threatening spears, the goblins stood there one by one, not daring to move or speak, and they stood silently for three hours.
Li Qinwu nodded with satisfaction. Sure enough, the goblins still needed to be beaten, so he had to use this method. If he continued like this, he was confident that he would cultivate the obedience of these goblins within a month, and he would be able to send troops after a month.
In addition to military training, Li Qinwu also had other preparations.
The first is to continue to level up. Li Qinwu takes his soldiers to hunt horned crocodiles every day. Not only does he need to level up, he also needs to level up his goblins.
These goblins were too short, and fighting humans was like a child fighting an adult. He had to train all 19 soldiers into level 2 soldier goblins.
For this reason, he had been grinding the Horned Crocodile for two days. Finally, the Gob Spear who followed him first had accumulated enough experience. Li Qinwu clicked Upgrade on the soldier management page and spent 80 Dinar to upgrade the Gob Spear into a Big Goblin.
Gobu Mao's height instantly climbed to 1.7 meters. He looked at his strong body in disbelief. The surging strength made him feel refreshed.
Li Qinwu pulled the Gob Spear in front of all the goblins, pointed at him and shouted: "Gob Spear is brave in battle! I gave him strength! From now on, he will be the second big goblin in the tribe!"
Don't you want the same power? Want to? If you want, just fight hard for me! "
Ding! You gave a successful speech, inspiring the enthusiasm of the goblins, and your Charisma proficiency +1.
Seeing the goblins' enthusiastic fighting spirit, Li Qinwu was very satisfied.If they can maintain this enthusiasm, it really won't be a problem to conquer the human tribe!
In the next few days, the horned crocodiles by the river suffered a lot. They were lured ashore by goblins and killed wildly. Many more goblins gained enough experience one after another, and Li Qinwu upgraded them all into big goblins.
The Big Goblin's fighting power is stronger than that of human males, and its intelligence is about the same as that of humans. Li Qinwu decided that when all the Goblins in his hand are promoted to Big Goblins, he will send troops to the human village!
